name: plongee-app
description: Orchestration locale des microservices backend (frontend et aquanature-mobile restent lancés séparément)

scripts.install:backend: npm --prefix backend/gateway-service install && npm --prefix backend/identite-service install && npm --prefix backend/activites-service install && npm --prefix backend/formation-service install && npm --prefix backend/materiel-service install && npm --prefix backend/finance-service install && npm --prefix backend/vie-associative-service install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,identite,activites,formation,materiel,finance,vie-assoc -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,white "npm --prefix backend/gateway-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/identite-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/activites-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/formation-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/materiel-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/finance-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/vie-associative-service run dev"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n gateway,identite,activites,formation,materiel,finance,vie-assoc,frontend -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,white,gray "npm --prefix backend/gateway-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/identite-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/activites-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/formation-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/materiel-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/finance-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend/vie-associative-service run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
